data.name: Brent
data.gender_notes: Brent is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Brent is derived from Old English ‘brond’ or ‘bryn’, meaning ‘bright’ or ‘hill’. In Old English literature, Brentan refers to a ‘bright raven’ or ‘bright ruler’. In the Christian tradition, Brent may represent the bright light of faith or a ruler of God's kingdom. The name Brent carries the meaning “Bright, Hill” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Brent usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, hill and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Brent belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, Hill.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brent total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_greek.name: Βρέντης
in_greek.long_meaning: Βρέντης ονομάζεται άνθρωπος που εργάζεται με πίστη και αφοσίωση. Ονομάζεται από τη λέξη 'βρέντος' που σημαίνει 'ανθρακωμένος' ή 'σκουριασμένος'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη δεν υπάρχει αναφορά με το όνομα Βρέντης. Ωστόσο, το όνομα έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί σε διάφορες χριστιανικές παράδοσεις ως τίτλος αγιότητας και σημαίνει 'άνθρωπος που είναι πιστός και αφοσιωμένος στον Θεό'.

in_latin.name: Brentius
in_latin.long_meaning: Brentius nomen significat hominem qui fidelissimus est et diligentissimus in opere Dei. Originem habet ab verbo 'brennes' quod significat 'ardere' vel 'inflamari'. In early Christian tradition, Brentius est unus ex titulis sanctitatis, quae significat hominem qui est fidelissimus et obedientissimus Domino suo.

Additionally, “ruler” can symbolize the power and authority that God gives to His followers to spread His message and bring hope to others. Thus, a person named Brent may be seen as a shining example of faith and obedience to God's will.
